TEXT.source: kanakanavu.info, "S. Tsuchida 2003 Story 2", https://kanakanavu.info/language-documentation/s-tsuchida-2003-story-2.html. This story was originally recorded by Shigeru Tsuchida in February 1969. The speaker is Angaiana Paepuli. The site's phonetic transcription (PT) line only; not aligned to the recording.

FORM.notes: source writes "nimuɾu(u)tsaŋ"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear; its normalized line lacks them

S.FORM: te:paku pua-muamuaɾʉ sua nimuɾuuʦaŋ ta:mu miena

FORM.notes: source writes "i:kam(u)" here and "ikam(u)" in its normalized line; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear; source writes "kam(u)" here and "kam(u)" in its normalized line; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: timanau sua i:si i:kamu taatiŋi kavaŋvaŋ manasi: tavaɾaʔʉ kamu

FORM.notes: source writes "nimuɾu(u)tsaŋ"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear; its normalized line lacks them

S.FORM: sua nimuɾuuʦaŋ ta:mu miena ya niaɾanai kani aɾaʧin sua ʔu:su

FORM.notes: source writes "niaɾavaŋa(i)n"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: muɾuuʦaŋ sua niaɾavaŋain ya kaakʉkʉna kani
sua nimuɾuʦaŋ ya maiʦa kan ʦaʦa:n
u:na kan pu:kaɾikaɾi tapo:ʔi : ʦa:ɾei kya ʔu:usu nimuɾuʦaŋ ta:mu misa kani
maɾivaɾi kan sua pu:kaɾikaɾi kan sua nanakʉ ʔu:su: nei sua i:sua ɾavai misa kani

FORM.notes: source writes "ma(k)asia"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: akun ʔuɾunamei masiɾaɾu makasia tapo:ʔi sien misa kani
muʦa:n kan ʦu makaasi tanaasa sua tia taʔeisia uʦaŋin
apakʉ:nei kan sua ʦauin sua ʔu:su
kuvʉ:ʧʉɾʉka misa kan kavaŋvaŋ sua ʦauini ʦau piniŋ

FORM.notes: source writes "ak(u)" here and "ak(u)" in its normalized line; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear; source writes "mak(a)sia"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: taɾava:vaɾi kan sua ʔu:su neinei tia ɾaʔʉv aku makasia misa kani
akya kan ʦu tavaɾain tia ɾaʔʉvin

FORM.notes: source writes "mas(i)ɾavaɾava"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: masiɾavaɾava kan sua eisi tavanvana

FORM.notes: source writes "tinakitu:mu(ɾa)"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: e:si kan tinakitu:muɾa ta:mu sua vi:luha
kuvʉ:ʧʉɾʉka ʔu:su misa kani
aranei kan ʦu inia ko: kan ʦu maamia kumʉnʉ
te: kan ʦu ʔaʦan ʦein-ana mataɾiŋʉntʉna kan
mapainpin kan ʦu ʔinia sua ʦauin
ma:kaɾikaɾi kan sua ʦauin mata uʦaŋin
te: mita ku:sa paakaʔʉn nan si makasia
kumiɾima pa tia ʧʉpʉŋ ʃu te: mita pa:kʉn naanu si makasia misa kani

FORM.notes: source writes "maɾ(i)kusa"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: aɾi-viʧ-i kan sa aneiin sua ʔu:su maɾikusa ʔumo:ʔuma
ʔaʦu ava kani ʦu sua ta:mu mukusa sa:na napakoʔiʦa na ca:-ca:n nakʉnakʉ ca:can napakoʔiʦa
pa:siki kusa inia sua navuŋin
pa:sikitʉvʉ sua na ɾapatʉ ta:mu mataiɾi kan
ʦau kan nimaɾumanʉŋ
poʔi kan ʦu miaɾuɾuvana aɾanei ʔumo:ʔuma maka:si kan ʦaʦa:n
pu:suaɾa:ɾatu tupuɾua sa:na ɾavei kisan kan kei sua aneiin ʔu:su
ʦau makananu misa kani sua aneiin

FORM.notes: source writes "ma:mi(a)"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: a:ʔavaɾaʔi ma:mia ʃi ʦau ki-saʉn kan aneiin
aɾaʦani kan ʦu tatupuɾua taɾakusa kan inia
e:si kani tinpuɾuin inia sua ʦa:au niɾuniŋasʉ kan nimatikuɾu kan kanasiaŋ
makataɾaʔʉna kan inia
masisuɾumu kani nai vuaʔi ikua kaki:ʧu su ʔu:su misa kani
mua kan ɾaʔʉvin sua isua
makai kan inia arakikaʦʉ mamanʉŋ ʦu ʧʉpʉŋ-in
aranei ʦu sua maka:si kan ʦu tana:sa

FORM.notes: source writes "taɾaʔuɾ(u)ei"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: taɾaʔuɾuei kan inia ʦumʉɾa sua vi:lua
akiya kan ʦu inia sua ta:mu
ŋuai avaai misa kani paʧʉpʉʧʉpʉŋ

FORM.notes: source writes "paɾ(a)tʉkʉnei"; the brackets appear to mark the letters as unclear

S.FORM: aranei ʦu inia ko: kan ʦu kei paɾatʉkʉnei sua saronei
kaʔan kan ʦu tavaɾaʔʉ aɾaʦakan
muaɾaŋatʉ kan ʦu inia sua maɾa-kʉɾakʉɾapʉ tia aɾaini si: kaʔan ʦu paɾauɾumʉn nanakʉ sua saɾonei
